chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman about 26, long wavy dark-brown hair worn loose, light natural makeup, wearing a teal satin button shirt and white wide trousers
chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man about 30, short black hair, neatly trimmed black beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother about 55, wearing a plum-purple djellaba and a cream headscarf
chars.DAD: a Moroccan father about 60, grey moustache, wearing a light grey djellaba and a white knitted cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the husband's seat on the sofa: WIFE sits next to him in a cosy modern Moroccan living room in Safi at night, turning her smartphone screen toward the viewer with a playful teasing smile, eyebrows raised, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, warm lamp light. The phone screen is just a soft glow, no readable content.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot on the sofa: WIFE leans toward HUSBAND holding up her phone, grinning and asking him something with curiosity; HUSBAND looks at the glowing phone screen with an awkward, embarrassed half-smile, rubbing the back of his neck. Moroccan cushions, evening lamp light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: WIFE laughs relaxed and carefree, waving her hand casually, totally not jealous, while HUSBAND stares at her surprised and confused, mouth slightly open. Living room sofa, warm evening light, comic mood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a small modern Moroccan kitchen: HUSBAND, holding a glass of mint tea, asks with a puzzled frown and open palm; WIFE shrugs with a calm smile, leaning on the counter, one hand open as if saying 'do whatever you want'. Daylight from the window.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND alone on a small apartment balcony at night in Safi, leaning on the railing, staring into the distance, deep in thought, one hand on his beard, city lights and the ocean faintly in the background. Thoughtful, slightly worried mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the hallway: HUSBAND stands half-hidden at the kitchen doorway in the foreground, watching suspiciously; in the kitchen WIFE calmly stirs a tagine pot, humming, looking innocent and relaxed. Curious, suspicious mood.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In his parents' traditional Moroccan salon with patterned sedari cushions: MOM serves tea and talks, while HUSBAND sits silent and distracted, staring at his tea glass, keeping something to himself.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan neighbourhood cafe terrace: HUSBAND sits with DAD at a small table with two glasses of coffee; DAD reads a newspaper calmly while HUSBAND opens his mouth to speak, then hesitates, embarrassed, hand half raised. Daytime.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: At home at lunch: HUSBAND sits at the dining table in the foreground with a full plate he has not touched, staring blankly, lost in thought; in the soft-focus background WIFE sits on the sofa smiling at her phone. Midday light, quiet tension.
